subject: Cross-Desk Workshop: slotting, venue access & AV runbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sally Tran <sally.tran@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-Desk Workshop: slotting, venue access & AV runbook

Hi Sally —

Following up on our prep call last week. We want to lock the two-day onsite workshop for the Cross-Desk migration project (technical deep-dive + exec alignment). To make booking and travel easier, could you confirm which of these multi-timezone windows works best for your team? We picked windows to span APAC stakeholders without forcing midnight hours for EMEA.

Option A: Tue/Wed, Oct 26–27 - Redwood HQ (San Francisco)
  - Ideal for execs traveling from EMEA (arrive Mon evening)
  - Core working hours 09:00–17:30 PT

Option B: Thu/Fri, Nov 4–5 - Customer site (Acme HQ)
  - Better for APAC engineers to join morning deep-dives virtually
  - Core working hours 10:00–18:30 PT

If neither, propose two alternate date ranges and we’ll confirm availability and start reserving travel.

Logistics notes we’ll need once a window is chosen:
- Final attendee roster + travel profiles (dietary/visa)
- Onsite room and AV requirements (we have a standard 40-person boardroom)
- Any badge/visitor pre-approval forms for Acme security

I attached a short AV runbook and will send calendar holds once dates are firm.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute slot if you want to triage.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: AV_Runbook_v1.pdf (summary of projector, mics, and breakout room needs)

From: Sally Tran <sally.tran@acme-corp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: acme.ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 05 Oct 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-Desk Workshop: slotting, venue access & AV runbook

Hi Irene —

Thanks — appreciate the options. Option B (Nov 4–5 at Acme HQ) looks preferable for our executive calendar and gives our APAC engineers an easier morning sync. A couple of items from our side:

- Confirmed attendees: Sally Tran (Exec sponsor), Matt Li (Platform lead), Priya Rao (Security), James O. (Solutions). We’ll share a full roster by Oct 15.
- Visitor pre-approval: I’ve started the badge request for external vendors; you’ll need to complete the attached vendor background form.
- AV: Our conference room has ceiling HDMI, USB-C breakout, and a Crestron panel. Please confirm if that matches your runbook.

We’re good with a Redwood-facilitated breakout for the day-2 hands-on workshop (30 seats). Can you send a high-level agenda and any prework for attendees?

Sally
Sally Tran
Senior Director, Platform Operations — Acme Corp
sally.tran@acme-corp.com | +1 (212) 555-0890

Attachment: acme_vendor_bg_form.pdf (we will forward once completed)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Oct 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-Desk Workshop: slotting, venue access & AV runbook

Irene / Marissa —

Acme picked Option B (Nov 4–5). Quick ops checklist from my side so we can hand off to events and travel:

1) Travel timeline
  - Red team (Irene + Marissa): fly Nov 3 evening, return Nov 6 morning
  - Bring spare HDMI adapters + USB-C hub (we still see adapter issues on Crestron panels)

2) Onsite AV
  - Confirm Crestron compatible laptop config and that we have an extra wireless lapel mic (2x).
  - Request production check on Nov 4 at 08:30 local. We’ll mark as "AV dry run".

3) Access & security
  - Need Sally’s completed vendor form by Oct 20 to get badge pre-approval.
  - If Acme requires NDAs signed on arrival, add to packet.

4) Agenda / prework
  - Day 0 (eve Nov 3): Exec dinner (Sally suggested onsite catering) — confirm headcount by Oct 25.
  - Day 1: Architecture deep-dive / migration constraints / performance SLOs (AM), breakout sessions (PM).
  - Day 2: Hands-on integration + ops runbook; close with rollout playbook and action items (PM).

5) Calendar holds & artifacts
  - I’ll draft a two-day calendar hold .ics and a one-page attendee prep doc. Marissa can publish the Drive folder once we commit dates.

Irene — want me to open a ticket with Events for catering + travel booking?

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Program Manager, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

References: internal events checklist, AV_Runbook_v1.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sally Tran <sally.tran@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-Desk Workshop: slotting, venue access & AV runbook

Hi Sally —

Great — Nov 4–5 is locked on our side. Attached are: 1) CrossDesk_Workshop_Hold.ics (two-day calendar hold for core participants) and 2) AV_Runbook_v1.pdf (the version Monica referenced).

Quick logistics and asks for Acme ops team before the visit:
- Please upload the completed vendor background form to the shared Drive folder by Oct 20: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-workshop-runbook
- Confirm headcount for the exec dinner by Oct 25 (we’ll coordinate menu restrictions)
- Can Acme ops confirm available room layout (the default is boardroom; we’ll need classroom-style for Day 2)

Proposed agenda (high level):
Nov 4 (Day 1) — Architecture + Exec alignment
09:00 — Welcome / goals (30m)
09:30 — Platform deep-dive (1h15)
11:00 — Breakouts (2x tracks)
12:30 — Working lunch / tech demos
14:00 — Ops & security requirements session (1h)
15:15 — Close & action items (45m)
Nov 5 (Day 2) — Hands-on integration + runbook
09:00 — Environment verification & hands-on labs (3h)
13:00 — Lunch
14:00 — Joint runbook and rollout rehearsals (2h)
16:00 — Final review / next steps (30m)

If that looks good, we’ll post the Drive folder and send final calendar invites to the confirmed roster.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Irene

Attachments: CrossDesk_Workshop_Hold.ics (calendar hold) | AV_Runbook_v1.pdf

From: acme.ops@acme-corp.com
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sally Tran <sally.tran@acme-corp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Oct 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-Desk Workshop: slotting, venue access & AV runbook

Thanks Irene — we’ve got the holds and the agenda looks aligned. I uploaded the vendor background form to the Drive folder (see link). Confirmed room layout: Day 1 boardroom, Day 2 classroom (capacity 32).

We’ll have on-site tech support for the AV dry run at 08:30 on Nov 4. Headcount for exec dinner currently 10 (will finalize Oct 25).

— Ops
Acme Facilities & Events
acme.ops@acme-corp.com
